epistemic_status: Post earlier camera results and a single 2012 source-probe NDVI=0.5484: new 2010-2013 season-average outcome frozen before full NDVI series. Regional environment only, not source camera greenness or animal behavior.
source: NASA MOD13Q1 v061 Terra 16-day NDVI via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC + anonymous SAS; product DOI 10.5067/MODIS/MOD13Q1.061

spatial.selection: same public representative point as earlier 2010–13 ERA5 atmospheric reanalysis

temporal.matched_period_source: original published independent ERA5 season mirrors 2010/2011/2012 December21±k, k=7...180 (522 pairs)
temporal.NDVI_temporal_alignment: ONLY most recently completed 16-day Terra composite with end date <= paired calendar day (never future lookahead), age <=20d
temporal.single_scene_first_source_probed: MOD13Q1.A2012017.h21v09.061.2021203222829 (QA good=9/9, source NDVI 0.5484); this item value does not select favorable dates

quality.if_scene_missing_or_low_quality: scene NDVI null; no carry-forward beyond last completed good 16-day composite; if nearest temporal source scene is clouded, pair is missing instead of reaching further back

results.report_per_year: Number of original 174 day mirrors with both branch NDVI present; mean+median and p10/p90, fractions positive and negative of falling-minus-rising NDVI, result only if >=0.60 coverage
results.report_all_cycles: Mean/median NDVI contrast on available original 522 fixed date pairs, but DO NOT treat pairs as independent climate replications
results.output_readiness: If fewer than 60% pair coverage for a cycle, mark that year insufficient and do not make interpretive sign claim
results.independent_data_integrity: STAC item IDs and dates, original asset scale, COG QA pixels, exact source-returned scene receipts
results.source_volume_bounds: At most 150 Terra scenes / 6 search pages, no unbounded input or download

interpretation.strong_scope: Can show whether one source public representative regional vegetation patch is greener in one branch than the other at similar astronomical daylength.
interpretation.weak_scope: Single 0.75 km region patch and original NDVI cloud screening is NOT biomass for all Serengeti grasslands or foliage around 186 source cameras.
